evaluation.subject: maths
evaluation.question: Show me multiple optimal solutions graphically when Z = 2x + 2y is maximized over x >= 0, y >= 0 and x + y <= 5.
must_show: labelled coordinate axes and a solid x + y = 5 boundary
the entire edge between (5, 0) and (0, 5) highlighted as optimal
must_not_show: only one endpoint marked as the unique optimum
an optimal interior point with x + y < 5
answer_facts: Corner objective values: Z(0, 0) = 0; Z(0, 5) = 10; Z(5, 0) = 10.
Maximum Z is 10 at every point (t, 5-t), 0 <= t <= 5.
There are infinitely many optimal solutions on the whole included edge.
